company.name: Velt
company.shortDescription: Complete collaboration toolkit for B2B: comments, notifications, recordings, multiplayer, huddles.
company.description: Velt is the complete collaboration toolkit for SaaS. With a full-stack SDK and APIs, product teams embed contextual comments, notifications, async recordings, CRDT-based multiplayer editing, presence, and huddles directly inside their apps—in days, not months. Built for B2B products, Velt is developer-first and enterprise-ready, helping teams ship rich, in-product collaboration without rebuilding realtime infra or compliance plumbing.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,770,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $21,811,342 to $21,811,342, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
